title: Source Document Annotation
description: Annotations attached to a source document in sources/. Captures known errata, stale cross-references, supersession, and other facts about the document's relationship to current law that aren't visible from the document itself. Annotation files live next to the document they describe, named <document>.notes.json.

annotates.description: Repo-relative path to the source document this file annotates.

annotated_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source document at the time the annotations were written. If the source's hash changes, these annotations need to be revalidated.

annotation_date.description: Date the annotations were last reviewed.

occurs_in.description: Where in the source document this annotation applies (section, page, count of occurrences, etc.).

as_published_text.description: Exact text or citation as it appears in the source document.

current_location.description: Where the substantively-equivalent text or authority lives today, if applicable.

resolved_by.description: Public Law, regulation, or other action that effected the change.

verified_date.description: Date this annotation's claim was independently verified against the current authoritative source.

verified_by_url.description: URL of the verification source consulted.
